## Issues

- The four-way isogeny characterization still needs equal dimension plus finite kernel to imply surjectivity. No general equidimensionality or fibre-dimension API was found.

The standing objective is partly advanced, not complete or terminally blocked. The next step requires a substantial new dimension-of-image argument, so the task was deliberately left running after verified, committed units and a clean integration check.

## Next

Use the new Noetherian and closed-stalk dimension results to prove that a proper closed image of an integral abelian variety has strictly smaller dimension unless it is the whole target. This should close the finite-kernel plus equal-dimension surjectivity direction before tackling flatness and the projectivity dependency chain.

The stop hook detected a post-commit durable mutation, most likely the graph synchronization/comment or task handoff written after the last source commit. I’m identifying the exact authored paths now and will commit only Milne-owned ledger changes, leaving concurrent workspace edits untouched.
